triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The registered red regression passes after staging bin targets are validated before old-dist eviction, both build wrappers are wired to promotion, and validation_plan exposes the regression by stable id and label. Missing or syntactically invalid package manifests remain benign, while non-absence read failures abort without replacing the working dist. Doctor emits the healthy contract marker only when the global package, PATH-selected command, declared bin-target realpath, compiled version, and host executable contract agree. POSIX validates executable access; Windows validates the actual npm command shim and PATHEXT-selected command. Canonical-main discovery failure and worktree targets remain non-pass. Capability skips and zero-assertion paths cannot emit the must PASS selector.

note: B-e256 fail-closed cross-platform contract after RI-010: AC-001 now binds the must missing-bin-target intent CHK-001:edge:0; immutable config-registration evidence remains separate from real validation_plan discoverability; implementation and regressions bind promotion wiring, PATH/package agreement, target containment, actual Windows shim script-position validation, and host-safe remediation.
